Coinbase is building the future of finance for people, institutions and their agents, with one place to trade crypto, equities, derivatives and prediction markets, use stablecoins, and connect AI agents with clear controls. You'll bring deep iOS or Android expertise to build core app surfaces, contribute to the design of Coinbase’s native mobile agentic workflow, and contribute to the foundation of Coinbase’s future mobile platform as product teams onboard to the native codebase.

  • Accelerate every other Frontend engineer at Coinbase by defining architectural patterns, improving build speeds, and defining optimal development workflows.

  • Contribute to the dual-app parity strategy during the transition period, identifying and killing technical debt that matters while ensuring feature and bug fix synchronization between codebases.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of iOS or Android mobile software engineering experience (Swift/iOS or Kotlin/Android).

Job Title: Staff Threat Detection Engineer

Location: Tel Aviv

The Detection and Response Engineering (DaRE) team protects Chainalysis corporate assets and manages internal incident response. We reduce risk by building systems that detect and contain malicious activity while performing high-stakes digital forensics. Our mission is to ensure that as blockchain adoption grows, our own infrastructure remains resilient against evolving threats.

As a Staff Threat Detection Engineer, you are the technical lead for our corporate threat detection strategy. You design high-fidelity detections, lead proactive threat hunting, and perform critical risk assessments for both corporate and product engineering functions. This is a high-profile role where you will act as a subject matter expert (SME) for threat modeling, guiding security best practices across all corporate functions.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Lead Detection Strategy: Own the end-to-end roadmap for corporate threat detection, mapping coverage against frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK.

  • Engineer High-Fidelity Detections: Design and maintain scalable detection logic across SIEM, EDR, and cloud logging platforms (AWS/GCP).

  • Conduct Threat Hunting: Plan and execute hypothesis-driven hunting campaigns to uncover novel TTPs and turn findings into durable controls.

  • Perform Risk Modeling: Lead threat assessments and design reviews for new technology on-boarding and product design changes.

  • Optimize Response: Partner with Incident Response to refine alert quality, automate triage playbooks, and reduce time-to-containment.

  • Mentor & Influence: Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the DaRE team while influencing product teams to improve visibility and remediate gaps.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • 8+ years of experience in detection engineering, SOC, or incident response at scale.

  • Deep expertise in building and tuning detections within SIEM, EDR, and log analytics platforms.

  • Advanced proficiency in writing complex detection queries (e.g., KQL, SPL, SQL).

  • Demonstrated experience detecting modern attacker TTPs across endpoint, identity, and cloud environments.

  • Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash) for automation and enrichment.

  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional security initiatives with IT and Engineering stakeholders.

Nice to have experience:

  • Experience leading threat hunting in cloud-first or SaaS-heavy environments.

  • Familiarity with securing AI integrations and managing associated security risks.

  • Knowledge of blockchain ecosystems and threats specific to the Web3/Crypto space.

  • Prior experience in a Staff-level technical leadership or mentorship role.

  • Red teaming experience against web technologies

  • OSINT and investigations

Technologies we use:

  • SIEM, EDR, and Log Analytics platforms

  • AWS, GCP

  • Python, Bash

  • KQL, SPL, SQL

  • MITRE ATT&CK Framework

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

About the company
 
Hi, we're Ondo Finance. Our mission is to provide institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services. We have both a technology arm that develops decentralized finance technology, and an asset management arm that creates and manages tokenized funds. We are the global leader in tokenized treasuries, tokenized stocks and ETFs, and are building the future of institutional-grade financial services onchain.
 
Founded by folks from Goldman Sachs Digital Assets Team, we’re backed by some of the best investors in the world including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, Tiger Global, and more. We are currently the leaders in the space in terms of AUM and are well capitalized to continue growing the firm. We're fully remote, with team members across the U.S.
 
About the role

Ondo Finance is looking for a visually driven Mid to Senior Product Designer to shape consumer mobile that help people interact with and trade sophisticated financial products. Your primary focus will be native iOS and Android experiences that make complex financial actions feel clear, intuitive, and easy to use.

This is a hands-on role for a designer who has a track record shipping consumer apps and cares deeply about how a product looks, feels and responds. You'll work from early product definition through detailed interaction design and launch, creating polished interfaces, thoughtful motion, and mobile interactions that help users understand what is happening at every step. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Research to influence product direction and raise the quality bar for Ondo's consumer experiences on mobile.

Target Outcomes
  • Create iOS and Android experiences that make complex financial products approachable, intuitive, and trustworthy for consumers.
  • A distinctive and polished visual experience across mobile, with strong typography, hierarchy, layout, and attention to detail.
  • Purposeful motion, animation, transitions, and feedback that clarify state changes, guide users through important actions, and make the product feel responsive.
  • Consistent mobile patterns and reusable components that respect iOS and Android conventions while creating a coherent Ondo experience.
  • Consumer journeys improved through user research, product analytics, and clear design KPIs.
  • Close collaboration between Design, Product, and mobile Engineering from concept through shipped implementation.
Responsibilities
  • Own the end-to-end design of consumer experiences for iOS and Android apps, from early flows and concepts through polished production interfaces.
  • Turn complex financial workflows into simple, understandable mobile journeys for consumers.
  • Define mobile navigation, information architecture, interaction models, gestures, transitions, loading states, and feedback.
  • Create high-fidelity visual designs, interactive prototypes, motion studies, and clear implementation guidance.
  • Set a high bar for visual craft across typography, color, hierarchy, composition, iconography, and interface detail.
  • Use motion and animation intentionally to communicate relationships, reinforce actions, and help users understand changes in state.
  • Build and evolve scalable mobile patterns and components while accounting for the conventions and strengths of both iOS and Android.
  • Partner closely with mobile engineers throughout development to refine interactions, resolve implementation details, and ensure the shipped experience matches the design intent.
  • Plan and participate in qualitative and quantitative user research, then use product analytics and design KPIs to guide iteration.
  • Present design rationale to stakeholders, gather feedback, and turn it into clear next steps.
  • Advocate for consumer needs, accessibility, and product quality at every stage of development.
Requirements
  • 5+ years of mobile product design experience, preferably in consumer technology, fintech, or similarly complex digital products.
  • A proven track record of shipping consumer-facing native apps for iOS and Android.
  • Experience with Web3, DeFi, or financial products, whether onchain or offchain.
  • A portfolio that shows live mobile products, end-to-end product thinking, strong interaction design, exceptional visual craft, and the outcomes of your work.
  • Deep understanding of mobile interaction design, touch and gesture patterns, platform conventions, navigation models, and responsive interface behavior.
  • Fluent in mobile design patterns including iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Android Material Design
  • Strong visual design skills across typography, color, hierarchy, layout, iconography, and detailed UI execution.
  • Experience designing motion, transitions, microinteractions, and animation for mobile products, with the judgment to use them purposefully.
  • Expert proficiency in Figma or equivalent product design and prototyping tools.
  • Strong command of information architecture, accessibility, and user-centered design fundamentals.
  • Experience owning work from problem definition and prototyping through engineering collaboration, launch, and iteration.
  • Examples of simplifying complex consumer problems through strong product thinking and design craft.
  • Clear communication skills and the ability to explain design decisions and influence product discussions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing transactional, data-rich, or trust-sensitive consumer apps.
  • Familiarity with user research methods and analytics platforms.
What we offer
  • Competitive compensation including but not limited to salary, future token rights, and/or equity (according to your preferences) — We are well-funded and believe that great talent deserves great compensation.
  • Full benefits (medical, vision, and dental) and flexible vacation policy (PTO).
  • Remote-first team across many countries — You will be an early team member helping shape our vision, culture, and design practices.
  • A+ colleagues — Our team includes alumni from: Goldman Sachs, Blackrock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Circle, Uniswap.
  • Best-in-class investors — We are proud to be backed by leading crypto experts and VCs, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund and Coinbase Ventures.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Payments Team, based in the US. Payments is where OKX meets the real financial world. Our team has built and operates the infrastructure connecting OKX to dozens of payment channels across global markets, giving users deposit and withdrawal options that are fast, convenient, and — most importantly — trustworthy. That platform moves and safeguards user assets at institutional scale, continuously, across time zones and regulatory environments.
 
This is not a greenfield team looking for its footing. The team is established, the platform is in production at scale, and we are actively expanding — both in scope and in headcount. That combination is rare: you get the leverage of joining a growing team where your work visibly shifts the roadmap, along with the discipline that comes from a system already trusted with real money.
 
It's also an unusually good place to learn. Payments is a domain that's hard to pick up from the outside — every market has its own rails, its own settlement behavior, its own failure modes, its own compliance expectations. Here you'll work across a wide range of payment methods and channels, and you'll build the judgment that comes from operating financial systems where the stakes are real: how to design for correctness when money is on the line, how to reconcile, how to recover, how to keep a platform observable enough that you find problems before your users do.
 
You'll work closely with product managers, designers, and partner-facing teams, and you'll set the technical bar for the engineers around you — through design docs, code reviews, and the everyday habit of doing things properly when nobody's watching.
 
If you like the sound of a team where the problems are genuinely hard, the standard is high, and your opinion changes the outcome, we'd like to talk.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design and build the core. Develop high-scale, 24/7 APIs and distributed payment services across multiple cloud providers, using Java and Spring Boot as the primary stack. Own systems end to end, from design doc through production ownership.
  • Expand our global reach. Help integrate and scale new payment channels and methods across markets, each with its own technical, operational, and reliability characteristics.
  • Protect user assets. Build for correctness first: consistency, idempotency, reconciliation, failure recovery, and the operational tooling that lets us stand behind every transaction.
  • Build with AI agents across the engineering lifecycle, and help set the patterns for using them safely on systems that move money.
  • Use AI development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) in your daily workflow to speed up coding, unit testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Set the technical bar. Participate actively in design and code reviews, giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback. Help evolve the standards a growing team builds on.
  • Solve the hard problems. Investigate complex distributed-systems challenges and drive them to resolution rather than handing them off.
  • Partner across functions. Work with product, design, and partner teams across regions to turn ambiguous requirements into shipped systems, and to unblock dependencies before they become delays.
  • Grow the team’s capability. Mentor engineers and share what you learn. Seniority here is measured in leverage, not just output.
  • Stay curious. Keep pace with a fast-moving industry and bring the good ideas back.
  • Collaborate directly with Mandarin-speaking partners, vendors, and clients to manage daily communications, gather project requirements, and resolve operational issues.

What you'll take away from this role

  • Deep, practical fluency across a wide range of global payment methods and channels, knowledge that is genuinely hard to acquire anywhere else
  • Experience designing and operating systems entrusted with substantial user assets, where correctness and recoverability are non-negotiable
  • A track record of shipping in a regulated, high-stakes domain at real scale
  • Hands-on experience applying AI agents and agentic engineering to production systems that move money

What We Look For In You

  • 7+ years of backend software development experience, with a proven track record of building and operating high-availability, large-scale applications.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and software design patterns, and the judgment to know when to reach for which.
  • An AI-first mentality. You use AI to extend your knowledge and capability and to work in complex systems with confidence.
  • Familiarity with agentic engineering.
  • Enjoy using AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity, while keeping a strong focus on engineering quality and best practices.
  • Ownership instinct. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tickets. When something’s broken or unclear, you move toward it.
  • Ability to drive cross-team collaboration, managing complex dependencies and competing requirements without losing momentum.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, and comfort operating with autonomy in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication. You can explain a complex technical trade-off to an engineer and to a non-technical stakeholder, and land it with both.
  • Genuine interest in crypto or fintech, and in building things that make money move better.
  • Preferred: Professional working proficiency in both English and Mandarin (verbal and written) to effectively communicate with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders and review Chinese-language business documents.

In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In eight years time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over two million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.

About the Role

The Finance Manager owns finance, regulatory reporting and financial control for Bitvavo Europe Limited (BEL), Bitvavo’s operations in Cyprus.

You will take over the quarterly CySEC and IFR returns, the statutory accounts and audit, purchasing and approvals, and management reporting, building the local finance function as BEL resumes client operations.

You will report to the Head of Business Control in Amsterdam, and will work closely with the directors in Cyprus, Risk on the ICARA, Compliance, group Finance, Tax and Treasury, the external auditor and outsourced service providers.

As this is a local role, we are only considering candidates who are currently based in Cyprus and able to work from Limassol.

What You’ll be Doing

Regulatory Reporting

  • Prepare and submit the quarterly QST return to CySEC

  • Own the quarterly IFR prudential returns, covering own funds, K-factors, liquidity and concentration risk, preparing them in house or overseeing and approving the external compliance provider’s work before submission

  • Monitor own funds, capital headroom and liquidity against IFR requirements and flag breaches early to the Board and group Finance

  • Provide revenue and cost forecasts as input to the ICARA, which is owned by Risk

descriptions.job-1nrfzpb:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The Sales Account Director will join a team driving TRM’s go-to-market strategy in the US Private Sector market. This is a high-paced role, with a large volume of accounts that move quickly. The Account Director’s goal will be to expand and strengthen our foothold in the North American banking and large financial institutions space. We're looking for a customer-obsessed, consultative salesperson to own the entire sales process with new and existing customers. This person will be knowledgeable about blockchain intelligence and digital assets, and feel comfortable navigating complex processes to close six and seven-figure deals.

The impact you will have:

  • Connect with current and net new key stakeholders within your territory and identify what matters to them, what are their potential mission applications, who holds budgets, who makes decisions, who influences decisions, who owns which process

  • Spearhead the implementation of blockchain intelligence into customer workflows, driving towards intimate understanding of the customers' application of TRMs tooling and data to proactively find ways to improve the customers success.

  • Own, plan, execute, and/or quarterback activities to nurture client relationships, feedback loops, referrals, renewals, upsells, cross-sells, expansions

  • Create and execute strategic plans for your territory to not only ensure company goals are met across key revenue and churn metrics, but also new growth opportunities are discovered and pursued

  • Hone TRM product and customer vertical subject matter expertise to enrich every stage of the sales process from demonstrations to trial to customer advisory sessions to innovation workshops

  • Proactively gather and prioritize customer feedback and champion it within TRM

  • Develop a roster of happy customers that will refer new prospects, champion TRM, and provide crucial feedback

What we’re looking for:

  • At least 8+ years of experience selling SaaS products, or 4 years experience accompanied with expert customer domain and mission knowledge and a background in consulting

  • Experience with virtual currencies, applications, and their use in financial networks

  • Strong knowledge of crypto-native organizations as well as their workflows, procurement processes, and organizational structures

  • Strong customer-facing presentation/listening skills with the ability to establish credibility with senior executives

  • Familiarity with Anti-Money Laundering (AML) regulatory framework

  • A knack for storytelling. You have the ability understand customer needs and build + convey compelling value propositions

  • Ability to operate a large volume of accounts that develop quickly

  • You find excitement or fulfillment through developing meaningful client relationships, identifying new use cases, obsessing over customer happiness, meeting new contacts within accounts, and closing deals

  • Adaptable. Goals can change fast. You anticipate and react quickly

  • Autonomous. You own what you work on. You move fast and get things done

  • Excellent communication. You will need to communicate complex ideas effectively

  • Collaborative. You must work collaboratively in a cross-functional team and with people at all levels in an organization

About the Team:

  • Our team thrives on collaboration, always looking out for each other by sharing opportunities and competitive insights. We actively exchange ideas and strategies to boost each other's sales efforts. Communication is key, and we primarily use Slack, making sure to @mention colleagues for timely responses. Our routine includes weekly 1-on-1 meetings with managers, bi-weekly team meetings, and monthly Pod meetings with the broader support organization. Above all, we prioritize our customers' missions, and this dedication is reflected in every aspect of our TRM life.

  • Our team predominantly operates in the EST timezone, with some members in PST. We start our day around 8:00 am and typically finish after 5:00 pm. While we may work beyond standard hours when necessary, we deeply respect family time and strive not to intrude on it. We're committed to contributing whenever needed, ensuring our team's success isn't confined to a 40-hour workweek.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Rapid Opportunity Assessment: You'll swiftly qualify or disqualify opportunities to ensure a strong, future-focused pipeline. Your goal is to add more than $500k in qualified pipeline each month, targeting next quarter and beyond.

  • Sales Campaigns: You'll develop two new sales campaigns each month to accelerate pipeline growth, with a focus on generating in-quarter opportunities.

  • Strategic Sales Planning: You'll regularly update and evaluate a strategic sales plan for all Tier 1 current customers and identify potential Tier 1 prospects on a monthly basis.

 

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Equal Opportunity

descriptions.job-0qd98cf:
DeFi Quant Research Intern - Digital Assets Market Making

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

 

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

 

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

About the Internship Program

Our internship programme gives early-career talent the opportunity to build practical skills, contribute to meaningful projects and learn alongside experienced colleagues in digital finance.

Typically lasting six months and based in our Brussels office (London possible), each internship includes hands-on experience, clear learning goals and dedicated guidance and regular feedback. We look for curiosity, relevant foundational skills, deep, active interest and passion for digital assets and the potential to grow exponentially with us - you don’t need to arrive with all the answers. Where performance, business needs and available opportunities align, an internship may lead to a permanent role, though this is not guaranteed.

We are looking for 3-4 high-caliber Quantitative Analyst Interns to sit within our Strategic Market Making (CeFi and DeFi), Credit and Corporate Development desks/teams (see other openings on our career page for details).

Application deadline: 30 November 2026
Start date: 1 March 2027

Selection process:

  • Interview with Talent Acquisition representative

  • Interview with Hiring Manager

  • Recruitment Challenge


The role

About Strategic Market Making Desk
Our Strategic Proprietary Market Making team researches and deploys systematic trading strategies across digital asset markets. Within the DeFi track, we focus on how blockchain mechanics, protocol design and on-chain market structure shape liquidity, execution and risk.

As a DeFi Quant Research Intern, you will work alongside quantitative researchers, traders and engineers to study on-chain markets and support the development of data-driven trading strategies. You will analyse blockchain and market data, test hypotheses through backtesting and simulation, build research tooling, and investigate how real-world execution—including gas, transaction ordering, liquidity fragmentation and MEV—affects strategy performance.

 

This is a technical and applied internship. We are looking for someone who combines strong quantitative reasoning and coding skills with genuine hands-on DeFi experience. You should be curious about how protocols work beneath the interface and able to connect blockchain mechanics to market behaviour and trading outcomes.



Key Responsibilities - DeFi Quant Research Intern

  • Research on-chain market structure by analysing liquidity, price formation, participant behaviour and execution across decentralized markets.

  • Study how protocol mechanics, transaction ordering, gas, slippage, latency and MEV affect execution quality and strategy performance.

  • Formulate trading hypotheses and evaluate them using blockchain data, market data, backtests and simulations.

  • Build reusable Python tools and data pipelines for research, monitoring and performance analysis.

  • Analyse relationships between centralized and decentralized markets and identify their implications for pricing, hedging and risk.

  • Support live strategies through monitoring, post-trade analysis and investigation of unexpected performance.

  • Present findings clearly, including assumptions, limitations, risks and recommended next steps.

Who You Are/Key Requirements - DeFi Quant Research Intern

  • Quantitative and coding foundations: You are pursuing or recently completed a degree in mathematics, computer science, engineering, physics, quantitative finance or a related field. You are proficient in Python for data analysis and comfortable with SQL, Git and command-line workflows.

  • Practical blockchain understanding: You understand transactions, state changes, gas, blocks, consensus and finality at a working level, and can reason about how smart-contract interactions execute on-chain.

  • DeFi market knowledge: You understand AMMs, concentrated liquidity, swaps, liquidity provision, oracles and liquidations, and how decentralized execution differs from a centralized order book.

  • MEV awareness: You understand how transaction ordering and block construction can create arbitrage, liquidation, backrunning and sandwiching opportunities or risks, and how these dynamics affect execution.

  • Hands-on curiosity: You have used DeFi beyond coursework or social media. Ideally, you have built or analysed something yourself—such as an on-chain dataset, trading or monitoring script, AMM simulation, protocol integration or research project.

  • Trading judgement: You naturally question whether an apparent edge survives fees, gas, latency, slippage, adverse selection and changing market conditions.

  • Ownership and communication: You can structure an ambiguous problem, test assumptions and communicate findings and limitations clearly in English.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience querying blockchain data through RPCs, indexers, subgraphs or analytics platforms.

  • Ability to read Solidity, contract interfaces and event logs.

  • Exposure to Rust or another systems programming language.

  • Familiarity with non-EVM ecosystems or Layer 2 execution models.

  • A technical project demonstrating sustained interest in DeFi or on-chain markets.

Our offer

  • A 6 month paid internship at world-renowned digital assets company with accommodation provided for entirety or part of it

  • The opportunity to learn about digital assets and blockchain from a 30,000 ft view of the entire ecosystem

  • Working from one of Brussels newest, nicest and most advanced office spaces

  • A global, collaborative and tech-driven environment.

  • Autonomy & Impact - our flat structure means you can contribute your ideas from day one and help shape the foundation that will power Keyrock’s future business.

  • Culture of Excellence - we value nimbleness, drive for success, owner mentality and collaboration.

  • Opportunity to leave your mark and start your career in one of the most reputable companies in the digital assets world

  • We are envisioning for the internship to be based pre-dominantly in Brussels. It is possible for a selected candidate to be based in London, UK, provided at least 1-2 months onboarding period would be spent in Brussels together with the rest of the interns cohort.

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.
